Visit note | 2025-10-26 03:30 PM | Dr. Sabrina Chowdhury, Cardiology | Patient: Salma Dewan, 55, female. Mrs. Dewan attends for her first visit, reporting no direct physical symptoms but noting that her father had a heart attack at 55 and that high cholesterol was found on a routine test. She works as a security guard and the finding was picked up during an office health check in Keraniganj. She has no known comorbidities and denies chest pain or breathlessness. On examination: LDL cholesterol 6.1 mmol/L, BP 112/80 mmHg, pulse 86 bpm, weight 72 kg. Heart sounds are normal. Assessment: Dyslipidaemia. Plan: tests ordered before starting treatment, including a fasting lipid profile and liver function tests. No new prescription issued today. She was advised to reduce fried food, red meat, and ghee, walk 30 minutes daily, and aim to lose 3 kg. Follow-up after the test results are ready.
